items.title: Jordan Clarkson is one of only six non-centers averaging 3+ offensive rebounds per-36 minutes this season.
items.author: Tommy Beer
items.body_excerpt:
Jordan Clarkson is one of only six non-centers averaging 3+ offensive rebounds per-36 minutes this season. 

The other five are Scottie Barnes, Amen Thompson, Brayden Burries, Dyson Daniels and Keldon Johnson.

quote.text: Jordan Clarkson on Mike Brown saying he's the best teammate he's been around: "That's a great compliment, especially he's been around a lot of guys, a lot of players & been on great teams. But I'm just here trying to support the group. We're here for one goal and that's to win."
